3209.title: Tasks lifecycle duplicates startup reconciliation
3209.rootCauseOneLine: Lifecycle registration awaits the same full tracked-thread reconciliation twice, repeating SDK lookups for rows that remain non-terminal.
3209.proposedFix: Keep one startup reconciliation, remove the adjacent duplicate, and update lifecycle tests to require one SDK read per still-active tracked row.
3209.caveats: A row that becomes completed during the first pass is filtered out before the second pass; the duplicate applies to rows that remain non-terminal.
